title: One Trillion Kisses
style: jazz, upbeat, pop, feel-good, female vocals, happy, pop, swing, bright, world, feel-good, soul, light
lyrics:
[Intro]
[bright, upbeat synth/guitar riff]
Yeah, let's go
One, two, three

[Verse 1]
Woke up today with the sun on my face
Got that 336 signal, yeah, I'm findin' my place
There's a rhythm in the air, there's a light in the room
Sweepin' out the shadows, clearin' out the gloom
I got that skip in my step, watchin' the world spin around
I got a smile on my face, yeah, as I don't frown

[Pre-Chorus]
'Cause I like to sing, yeah, that's my thing
Step up to the mic like the bell ding
I enter the ring, bing, bing, bing
Let the good times roll, let the melody swing

[Chorus]
I've got one trillion kisses, rainin' down from above
One trillion kisses, surrounded by love
I'm the main attraction, I'm not to miss
Sealed and delivered with a trillion kisses
Happy as can be, yeah, the world is free
One trillion kisses for me

[Verse 2]
Walkin' down the street, got the beat in my soul
Takin' in the sights, yeah, I'm on a roll
Every little moment is a brand new start
Got a pocket full of sunshine and a wide-open heart
No heavy weather is ever gonna drag me down
I keep that smile on my face, yeah, as I don't frown

[Pre-Chorus]
'Cause I like to sing, yeah, that's my thing
Step up to the mic like the bell ding
I enter the ring, bing, bing, bing
Let the good times roll, let the melody swing
